evals.name: explicit-capture-cold-start
evals.prompt: I'm in the middle of fixing the login redirect bug, but I just realized our session tokens never get rotated after sign-in — that's a real problem but it's out of scope right now. Park that so I don't lose it.
evals.expected_output: Creates SCRATCHPAD.md at the repo root containing one entry (most naturally a task, possibly discovery) about session token rotation, in the H1/H2 Active/H3 entry format with a timestamped `· <type>` heading. Ensures SCRATCHPAD.md is gitignored. Does NOT start fixing token rotation.
assertions: Capture file is named SCRATCHPAD.md (skill convention)
Uses skill structure (# Scratchpad H1 + ## Active + ## Archive)
Entry heading uses '### YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM · <type>' with type task/discovery
Captured item is about session token rotation
Parking only — no source code changes for token rotation

evals.name: auto-capture-midtask
evals.prompt: Add basic input validation to the createUser function in src/users.js — reject empty or missing name/email before the insert.
evals.expected_output: Completes the in-scope validation task. ALSO silently parks the out-of-scope discovery that the query uses string concatenation (SQL-injection risk) into SCRATCHPAD.md as a discovery (and/or a task), printing a one-line `↳ parked in SCRATCHPAD:` notice. Does not derail into fixing the injection. Does not park trivia.
assertions: createUser validates & rejects empty/missing name and email before the INSERT
Capture uses skill format (SCRATCHPAD.md with # Scratchpad + '### … · <type>' entry)
SQL injection NOT fixed (string-concat INSERT still present) — scope respected
Inline 'parked in SCRATCHPAD' notice printed to the user (transparent capture)

evals.name: retrieve-lifecycle-promote
evals.prompt: What tasks are still open on my scratchpad? Mark the auth-guard one as done, and promote the flaky-CI task to a GitHub issue.
evals.expected_output: Lists the open (- [ ]) task entries. Ticks the auth-guard task to - [x] in place. For the flaky-CI task: drafts/creates a GitHub issue, moves the entry to the Archive section, and appends a `↳ promoted: issue #...` pointer line. Edits preserve the file format.
assertions: Auth-guard task remains in ## Active (ticked in place, not auto-archived)
Flaky-CI entry has standardized '↳ promoted: issue #215' pointer line
A GitHub issue (title + body) was drafted in the reply
Other Active items (Stripe question, config idea) left intact
